# Space Square

> AI consulting and custom software studio. We build AI solutions focused on real outcomes and measurable ROI — AI strategy, intelligent workflows and agents, and custom AI tools and apps.

Contact: info@spacesquare.dev
Website: https://spacesquare.dev

## Services
- [AI Strategy & Roadmapping](https://spacesquare.dev/services/ai-strategy): Identify high-impact AI opportunities and build a practical path to implementation.
- [Intelligent Workflows & AI Agents](https://spacesquare.dev/services/intelligent-workflows): Automate tasks, surface insights, and make smarter decisions in real time.
- [Custom AI Tools & Apps](https://spacesquare.dev/services/custom-ai-apps): Internal tools and applications tailored to specific business needs.

## Case studies
- [Bläz Entertainment](https://spacesquare.dev/work/blaz-entertainment): AI tools plus an iOS/Android app for event discovery, reservations, and engagement.
- [Transphere Inc.](https://spacesquare.dev/work/transphere): Custom AI web app automating freight shipment lifecycle updates and customer notifications.
- [Father & Son HVAC](https://spacesquare.dev/work/father-and-son-hvac): AI scheduling assistant handling appointments, reminders, and technician coordination.
